definitions.explanation: A person who professionally analyzes and critiques works of art, literature, politics, or other fields. Can also be used dismissively to describe someone who only criticizes without taking action themselves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A famous film critic praised this work highly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか}だ。
examples.english: He's just an armchair critic who only talks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}していた→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧。
examples.english: Political commentators were discussing the election results on television.

notes:
USAGE:
When used in its professional sense, {評論家|ひょうろんか} is neutral. However, when applied to an ordinary person, it often carries a negative connotation suggesting they criticize without contributing or acting themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか} (film critic)
- ⟦{文芸|ぶんげい}→文芸：12990_bungei⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか} (literary critic)
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか} (political commentator)
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧{評論家|ひょうろんか} (music critic)

FORMS:
⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧ (criticism, critique) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional suffix). The suffix ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ indicates a person who practices a skill or profession.
